resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1934 date belongs to the original pole tower on these footings; the structure standing now is the 1997 replica. The original year is still disputed (1934 in most guides, 1935 on the Silver Mountain trail page).

notes_for_editor: Record events list 1934 built; that matches the original tower, and the standing structure is the 1997 replica on the same footings, so a 1997 rebuilt event was added rather than changing the built year. Record height 6.1 m matches the original 20-foot pole; no source gives the replica's height, so height_m was not added to facts. Sources conflict on the original year (1934 vs 1935) and on staffing (Idaho Fire Lookouts says not staffed in recent years; willhiteweb says volunteers have staffed it). Trail length: 1.85 miles one way (Silver Mountain) vs 2 miles one-way (willhiteweb). Record access is not in the record; facts.access is public via the paid gondola. No photo added. Not visited.
